name: 39157 · Ridgeland, MS
findings: ZIP 39157 (Ridgeland) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39157 (Ridgeland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39157 (Ridgeland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 61 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
